events.title: Steam Next Fest Launch Stream!
events.summary: The dev is playing The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study. Drop in and ask any questions you want or give it a try yourself!

events.title: Extra Accessibility Settings For Steam Next Fest
events.summary: We've added a few extra accessibility settings prior to Next Fest!Game Accessibility Nexus provided some recommendations on how we can further improve the accessibility of The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study. events.title: Major Update for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: It's been a busy year! Major update for The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study going into Next Fest!Fully Voice ActedEvery note is narrated by professional voice actors who have brought the characters to life. On top of this being a massive boon for the game's immersion, it also supports our commitment to accessibility. events.title: Gamayo Update
events.summary: We had a great time exhibiting the demo for The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study at Gamayo! It was great to watch people play the game for the first time, and we even got to try out some awesome games ourselves. The players provided some great feedback.Many said the tentacle grab was lacklustre. Many people were confused about what counted as a clue and what wasn't.
